draftRequest.quotedEvidence: a) To promote installation of Grid connected Rooftop systems under NetMetering arrangement on large scale in private residential sectors, State Government will provide subsidy of Rs 15000/KW to a maximum limit of subsidy Rs 30000/- per consumer. reviewerNotes: Everything under draftRequest.locator / clauseEvidence[].locator needs charStart/charEnd (and the chunk's pageNumber/section/fragment) copied from the ARCHIVED derived text in the admin console. The quotes below are verbatim from the file fetched on 2026-10-11 with whitespace collapsed to single spaces; the archive's text extraction (pdf.js) can differ in spacing/line order. If a quote does not match the archive byte-for-byte, re-select the passage in the archive and replace the quote; do not edit numbers.
sourceId/documentId/documentVersion are placeholders (SRC#/DOC# values are assigned by the registry when the source is registered and the document crawled).
The server fills ruleId, policyId, policyVersion, factIds and every evidenceFactIds; do not send them.

Clause 7(b) (page 14) says 'a "Saurya Uttar Pradesh Yojna" is proposed to be implemented during the policy period'; clause 7.3 (page 18) says the subsidy 'will be provided'/'will be disbursed ... on reimbursement basis'. The policy is a 2022 document; no operational UPNEDA order for the current year was fetched. Confirm the scheme is live before publishing.

effectiveTo is not set: clause 3.2 says the policy remains in operation 'for a period of five (5) years or till the Government notifies the new policy whichever is earlier'. Once effectiveFrom is known, effectiveTo = effectiveFrom + 5 years is an admin computation from that clause; verify no new policy has been notified.

Not encoded: subsidy 'will be admissible only in those plants/projects which have been purchased /constructed after the date of promulgation of this policy' (page 39 of the PDF; needs the issuance date for an INSTALLATION_DATE_RANGE condition), and payment 'on reimbursement basis after successful installation and commissioning ... with net metering'.

The policy text does not say the subsidy is conditional on the consumer taking PM Surya Ghar CFA; it says it is 'in addition to any Central Financial Assistance available'. ADDITIVE is therefore drafted; reviewer should confirm against current UPNEDA guidance.
Press (not authoritative, not used as evidence) reports UP currently pays Rs 30,000 on top of central CFA, consistent with this clause.
